# Refunds and Credits

Northwind Cloud grants a refund window of 30 days from the date of each charge. [doc:doc_refunds] To request a refund, open the billing console, select the invoice, and choose Request refund. [doc:doc_refunds]

The Starter tier allows 60 requests per minute, Growth allows 300 requests per minute, and Business allows 1,200 requests per minute. [doc:doc_rate_limits] # API Rate Limits

Northwind Cloud enforces API rate limits per project. [doc:doc_rate_limits]

# Uptime SLA

Northwind Cloud guarantees 99.9% monthly uptime on the standard tier and 99.95% on the Business plan. [doc:doc_sla] The credit formula works as follows: 5% of the monthly fee for every 0.1% of downtime below the target, so credit percentage equals missed uptime divided by 0.1, multiplied by 5, capped at 50% of one monthly fee. [doc:doc_sla]

# Data Retention

Northwind Cloud keeps application logs for 30 days and backup snapshots for 7 days, after which both are permanently removed. [doc:doc_data_retention]

# Encryption

All data stored on Northwind Cloud is encrypted at rest with AES-256, using keys managed by the platform key service. [doc:doc_encryption] Encryption keys rotate automatically every 90 days, and Business plan customers can trigger a manual key rotation from the console at any time. [doc:doc_encryption]

# Status Page

The Northwind Cloud status page is published at status.northwind.cloud and shows real-time health for every region and for core services such as the API, console, and dashboard. [doc:doc_status_page] Incidents use three severity levels: severity 1 marks a full outage, severity 2 marks degraded performance, and severity 3 marks a minor issue without customer impact. [doc:doc_status_page]
